A small tool for bigger ideas. Token Split is an offline allocation planner built for Ethereum token communities and the IMD ecosystem. See where a supply would go before bringing your next idea to the swarm.

How the numbers work +

Each amount is the total supply × its allocation percentage ÷ 100. Percentages use steps of 0.1%. Amounts are exact, with up to three decimal places.

Unused supply stays unallocated. If the split goes over 100%, the chart pauses until you bring it back down. A finished plan must total exactly 100%.

This is a planning sketch. It does not read onchain data or model token decimals, vesting, prices, or voting power. Presets are examples, not recommendations. Refreshing the page clears your changes.

Made for the next community idea.No account. No connection. Just a plan.
